metricJustification: Metric Selected: RMSE (Root Mean Squared Error). Justification: In retail inventory demand forecasting, large forecast errors result in catastrophic business costs — under-forecasting leads to lost sales and customer churn (stockouts), while over-forecasting incurs high working capital depreciation and perishable waste. RMSE squares individual residuals before averaging, penalizing large discrepancies much more heavily than MAE. A candidate must achieve at least a 2.0% reduction in RMSE to justify model transition risk.
